tools.name: @google/design.md
tools.description: DESIGN.md format, linter, and diff tooling for giving agents a structured visual identity and design-system contract.

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: Validate a DESIGN.md file against the spec and report contrast, token, and structure findings.

commands.name: diff
commands.purpose: Compare two DESIGN.md files for token-level and prose regressions.

tools.agentUse: Reference when creating or reviewing UI that should follow a persistent visual identity. This is tooling/documentation, not an agent skill.

tools.name: codeburn
tools.description: Local dashboard and reporting CLI for visualizing AI coding token usage, cost, providers, models, projects, and task categories.

commands.name: status
commands.purpose: Show a compact today/month usage summary.

commands.name: report-json
commands.purpose: Export structured usage data for analysis.

commands.name: optimize
commands.purpose: Find token waste and setup improvements.

commands.name: models
commands.purpose: Generate a paste-friendly model usage and cost table.

tools.agentUse: Use CodeBurn when the user asks about AI token usage, cost, model comparisons, expensive sessions, or token waste. It is an observability/reporting tool, not a skill.

tools.name: codegraph
tools.description: Pre-indexed local code knowledge graph for AI agents. Tree-sitter extraction, SQLite + FTS5, auto-sync on file changes. MCP tool codegraph_explore returns surgical context, call paths, and blast radius in one call.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Wire CodeGraph MCP into detected agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, etc.)

commands.name: init
commands.purpose: Create .codegraph/ and build the project knowledge graph

commands.name: explore
commands.purpose: CLI equivalent of codegraph_explore — source, call paths, blast radius

commands.name: status
commands.purpose: Graph stats and pending sync after edits

commands.name: affected
commands.purpose: Find test files affected by changed sources

tools.agentUse: Use codegraph on large or unfamiliar repos when grep/read loops waste tokens. Prefer codegraph_explore (or codegraph explore) for how-it-works and impact questions; trust graph output instead of re-verifying every symbol with grep. Run codegraph init per project after a global codegraph install.

tools.name: autoskills
tools.description: CLI for automatically discovering and applying relevant agent skills from the current context.

commands.name: run
commands.purpose: Run autoskills through npx to inspect context and surface useful skills.

tools.agentUse: Use autoskills when the user wants automatic skill discovery or a quick context-aware skill recommendation pass.

tools.name: rtk
tools.description: Rust CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output (git, test runners, linters, cloud CLIs, and more) before it reaches the agent's context.

commands.name: git
commands.purpose: Compact git status, diff, and log output.

commands.name: grep
commands.purpose: Compact grep, grouped by file, whitespace stripped.

commands.name: test
commands.purpose: Run a test command and show only failures.

commands.name: err
commands.purpose: Run a command and show only errors and warnings.

commands.name: proxy
commands.purpose: Run a command unfiltered while still tracking usage.

tools.agentUse: Prefix shell commands with rtk when the user's global instructions require it, to keep tool output small. rtk passes commands through unfiltered when it has no matching filter, so prefixing is always safe. Use rtk proxy <cmd> for raw output needed for debugging.
